topic: Day 130 — reel — Gratitude only during good times isn't gratitude, it's relief
text:
Gratitude in
good times only
is just [relief].
caption:
A reaction to favourable circumstances disappears exactly when you'd need it most. The practised version is a lens, not a mood.

Follow for one of these a day.
